scripts.dev: npm run setup:dev && npm run setup:db && npm-run-all --parallel dev:frontend dev:backend
scripts.setup:dev: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='backend/.env.example';const dest='backend/.env';if(!fs.existsSync(dest)&&fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);console.log('Created backend/.env from backend/.env.example');}"
scripts.setup:db: npm --workspace backend run prisma:generate && npm --workspace backend run prisma:migrate:deploy && npm --workspace backend run seed
scripts.reset:local: npm run setup:dev && npm --workspace backend run prisma:generate && npm --workspace backend run prisma:migrate:reset && npm --workspace backend run seed
